title: Recollection and Incomplete-Collection Provisions — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Provisions for recollection visits and incomplete collections, Specimen Collection Appointments.** A recollection visit is one whose purpose is to collect again after a specimen was rejected; an incomplete collection is a visit at which the collection could not be completed.

| Visit type | Recollection visit carries no collection-service fee of any kind | Recollection slot guaranteed within (calendar days of the request) | Venipuncture attempts before the collection is recorded incomplete | Rebooked visit after an incomplete collection carries no fee (and the incomplete visit is assessed nothing) | Rebooked slot guaranteed within (calendar days of the incomplete visit) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | Yes | 0 (no priority) | 2 | Yes | 0 (no priority) |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | Yes | 3 | 2 | Yes | 3 |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | Yes | 3 | 2 | Yes | 3 |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | Yes | 7 | 2 | Yes | 7 |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | Yes | 5 | 2 | Yes | 5 |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Yes | 5 | 2 | Yes | 5 |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | Yes | 2 | 2 | Yes | 2 |

### Notes

- A priority figure of 0 means the visit type gives no guaranteed slot; any figure above 0 is the number of calendar days within which a slot is guaranteed.
- The venipuncture figure is the number of attempts per visit after which the collection is recorded incomplete; it is 2 for every visit type.
- Every visit type waives all collection-service fees on a recollection visit and on the visit rebooked after an incomplete collection.

### Hypothetical illustration

A recollection request for a Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection made on an invented day R is guaranteed a slot within 7 calendar days of R; the same request for a Facility Bedside Collection Visit is guaranteed a slot within 2 calendar days of R; for a Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit no slot is guaranteed.
